m. (-फः)
The penis.
E.
शी to sleep, फ aff.: see the next.

m. (-फः)
The penis.
E.
श changed to सः see शेफ, शेफस्, &c.

n. (-फः)
The penis.
E.
शी to sleep, (semine effuso,) असुन् aff., and फुट् augment; also with पुट augment, शेपस्, and with a final vowel, शेप or शेफ; again, व being substituted for प, शेव.

f. (-लिः-ली)
A plant: see the next.

f. (-का)
A flower, (Nyctanthes arbor-tristis.)
E.
शेफा sleeping, from शी with फ aff., अलि a bee, fem. aff. ङीष्, and कन् added; also शेफालि.
